sections.text_helper: Section 77.4.4 "HDP general-purpose output set register (HDP_GPOSET)" in chapter 77 (Hardware debug port (HDP)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 4370.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x014
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:8 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 7:0 HDPGPOSET[7:0]: When a bit is written to 1, the corresponding HDP GPO is set
Writing a bit to 0 has no effect.
